title: Minnet efter resan
lines: A small errand, a long memory.
Direction, story and the character Freyja: actualraptor

title: Characters and animation
lines: Edda and Pippa are VRoid Project sample avatars (AvatarSample_G and AvatarSample_E), CC0, from the "VRoid Studio CC0 models" pack on OpenGameArt.
Humanoid animation: Universal Animation Library by Quaternius, CC0.
Jump and landing motion: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), free for use.
Practice-range monsters: Animated Monster Pack by Quaternius, CC0.

title: Engine and code
lines: VRM importer: godot-vrm by V-Sekai, MIT.

title: Fonts
lines: Cormorant Garamond, SIL Open Font License 1.1.

title: Sound and music
lines: Sound effects and ambience are synthesised for this game.
Music is composed for this game and rendered with the GeneralUser GS soundfont by S. Christian Collins.
